Watch the title track of Rajinimurugan in D.Imman's music & Yugabharathi's lyrics. Sivakarthikeyan sings this song about himself and his carefree fun loving attitude.
Song Name - Rajinimurugan
Movie - Rajinimurugan
Singer - Sivakarthikeyan
Music - D. Imman
Lyrics - Yugabharathi
Director - Ponram
Starring - Sivakarthikeyan, Keerthi Suresh
